paper_title: Axion dark matter search from terrestrial magnetic fields at extremely low frequencies
notes: Axion DM search using terrestrial magnetic field data at Eskdalemuir observatory (ELF band 0.3-30 Hz), constraining axion-photon coupling for m_a between 1e-15 and 1e-13 eV. Best limit g_agamma <~ 4e-13 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 3e-14 eV. The paper does not provide a numerical table of the limit curve; data points are approximate reconstructions from stated text values (best 4e-13 at 3e-14 eV, and 1.3e-11 at 0.263 Hz ~ 1e-15 eV mass). Mass edges are approximate. rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed. 95% CL. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 32)) | Vision: Blue 'This work' region spans ~10^-15 to 10^-13 eV (0.3-30 Hz), with tightest limit ~5e-13 GeV^-1 near 3e-14 eV, consistent with text stating limit g_agamma < 1.3e-11 at 95% CL at some frequency and improvement over CAST by ~2 orders.
